## Welcome!

Hello! I am a graduate student pursuing an MS in Biostatistics at Columbia University's Mailman School of Public Health.

My academic interests include biostatistics, public health data science, and statistical analysis.

## About This Website

This website introduces my academic background, professional experiences, and data science projects. You can learn more about my education and experiences on the Resume page.
